resources.string: Installed in %1$s. You will see it at the next start.
The original boot animation is back.
Nothing to restore: the boot animation was never changed.
The unit\'s own boot animation and still logo are put back.

Changes what the unit shows while it starts, with this brand\'s logo: the Android animation, and the still logo if switched on. Uses the head unit\'s internal root ADB and never touches /system. Originals are backed up (also to Dashwheel/boot_backup on the internal storage) and Restore puts them back. Logos come from the open car-logos-dataset.
Saved on %1$s. Unplug the stick and plug it back in: the unit imports the animation. For the still logo: Settings → Factory settings (8888) → Logo set → pick %2$s → Update logo.
No USB stick found. Plug one in and try again.
The first picture, before Android. Off by default: it is written to the logo partition, backed up first and checked after.
The still logo is written to the unit\'s logo partition, backed up first.
this unit has no still-logo tool
Install now only works on the QF001 / K706 firmware it was made for. Use Save to USB instead.

The head unit\'s internal ADB isn\'t answering (port %1$d) and Dashwheel has no root. Turn on USB debugging (Settings → About → tap Build number 7 times, then Developer options → USB debugging), or grant root, and try again.
